name: print-social-healthy-lifestyles-posts-purple-gradient-flat-illustration
title: 'Let's Increase Knowledge About Healthy Lifestyles' pack with purple-orange gradients and flat wellness illustrations
whatItIs: Nine posts on purple-to-orange gradients with a white content card, flat illustrations of people meditating, cycling and walking dogs, circular icon badges, headlines ('Commit to a Fit Healthy Lifestyle', 'The Benefits of Cycling Burn Cardio') and a consistent logo and colour dot pagination.
whatItMeans: Uplifting and consistent; a repeated card-on-gradient format with varied wellness illustrations keeps a health series visually cohesive.
techniques: Float a white content card over a full-bleed gradient background.
Illustrate a different healthy activity per post within one style.
Use dot pagination indicators to imply a longer content series.

vocabulary.definition: A distinct panel holding the main message, floated over a background.
Small dots indicating position within a series of items.
